facts.fact: Travizory says its FaceLane facial-recognition border corridor is deployed in Seychelles for citizens and resident diplomats, within an eBorder platform that classifies travellers by AI-powered pre-travel risk assessment.

systems.platform: biometric border corridor with AI risk scoring
